name: unreal
description: Unreal Engine kits and skills: script an open editor, build levels from data with Landscape and PCG, compile and capture the game unattended.

interface.shortDescription: Script the editor, build worlds from data, capture the real game
interface.longDescription: Kits are source copied into your Unreal project: shell drivers to compile C++ and run the game unattended at three levels of cost, a ready gate so neither a capture nor a player sees a level that is still loading or a character in its bind pose, a bridge to an open editor, scripted screenshots, optional local environments for subagents, and a level builder that makes terrain, paint layers and scatter from one data file. Skills teach the working loop and its pitfalls.
defaultPrompt: Use $gam3stack-unreal-kits to set this project up for unattended builds and screenshots.
Use $unreal-editor-loop to make this change and show me a screenshot from the game.
Use $unreal-readiness to check what a player sees in the first seconds of this level.
